correctness.rationale: For rotation-equivariant P,Q with Q(s)>0, direct differentiation gives ds/dt=2sP(s), dtheta/dt=Q(s), so every nonconstant periodic orbit lies at a positive root s_i of P. The physical period is 2pi/Q(s_i) and log(mu_i)=2s_iT_iP'(s_i). Hence P=(s-s1)(s-s2)B and B(s1)=-log(mu1)/(2s1T1(s2-s1)), B(s2)=log(mu2)/(2s2T2(s2-s1)). Same-sign Floquet logs force opposite signs of B node values and an extraneous positive root. Opposite-sign Floquet logs give equal-sign node values: the degree-0, degree-1, and strictly nonvanishing degree-2 B alternatives give exactly degrees 5,7,9, including the boundary c2=(s2/s1)c1, with Q=omega1*l1^2+omega2*l2^2 globally positive. Exact rational independent calculations checked five representative node datasets, derivatives, degrees 5/7/9 and the forbidden affine root. This reconstructs the unrestricted-in-parameters proof within the stated restricted class; not an arbitrary planar-field result.
